title: introduce-cost-horizon-batcher-curves-and-forecasting-presets
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Provide a lightweight forecasting layer that automatically derives per-workload batcher curves and suggests conservative cost/latency defaults for batching, prefill, and quantization profiles. This PR introduces a new 'cost-horizon' component that ingests short-term telemetry (30m-6h) and synthesizes expected token throughput vs tail-latency curves for a given model+route. Goals: 1) reduce time-to-safe-defaults when onboarding new routes; 2) provide explainable fallback defaults for Dedicated/Private deployments; 3) feed the Optimize recommendations UI with a compact curve summary. Scope: runtime batcher heuristics, a small forecasting service, telemetry enrichers, CLI to export curve presets, and docs for operators. Checklist: [x] batcher curve model & API; [x] telemetry enrichment; [x] fallback default generator; [x] CLI export/import; [x] unit + smoke tests; [x] docs and changelog entry. Non-goals: global autoscaler policy changes, model architecture changes. Rollout plan: staged rollout behind feature-flag 'econ-horizon' on Canary, validate against existing unit-econ baselines, then enable for 10% traffic, then gradual ramp. Backout: feature-flag toggle and simple reversion of generated defaults to previous safe-presets. Related: ENG-1987 (cost-defaults workstream), SUP-4231 (customer reported batch regressions).

d1e4b66: docs and examples for ops
changed_files_snippets: runtime/batcher/curve_consumer.go: added ApplyCurve(ctx, curvePreset) to bias batch size selection; conservative default multiplier applied.
services/econhorizon/service.go: new HTTP endpoint /v1/curve-summary?route=<id> returns compact curve: [p50_throughput,p95_throughput,p99_latency_ms] as CSV string.
telemetry/enrichers/route_windower.rs: sliding 5m windows aggregated into 30m and 6h rollups to feed the forecast model.
console/src/components/Optimize/curve-summary.tsx: small UI to preview suggested preset and explain expected delta in tokens/sec and tail latency.
review_comments: Connor Li: Can we avoid adding an additional protobuf layer for the curve and reuse existing preset proto? Author: opted for a compact object to keep evolution simple; will add compatibility shim in next patch.

Marta Kowalski: Request stronger guardrails for disabled feature-flag paths to ensure no metric leaks to hosted customers. Author: added config flag in pkg/config and ensured stats are only emitted when econ-horizon.enabled=true.

Diego Ramirez: Benchmark numbers? The per-route sampling looks expensive. Author: microbenchmarks added; sampling at 1/10 request rate with aggregation keeps CPU overhead <0.7% on 8-GPU nodes (see tests/e2e).
QA (Ivy Zhang): Found flaky test in e2e that depends on wall clock. Author: replaced time.Sleep with deterministically injected clock in test harness.
release_notes: Add cost-horizon forecasting component that generates per-route batcher curve presets and conservative defaults for batching, prefill, and quantization. Disabled behind feature flag econ-horizon. Provides CLI export/import and UI preview in Optimize.
notes_on_verification: Canary rollout validation showed median throughput unchanged, p95 latency improved for batchable workloads by ~6-12ms with no increase in error rate. Cost-projection delta for a sample fleet decreased by ~3.4% in simulated 72h replay. Monitoring: added temporary dashboards under Optimize -> Cost Horizon for first 72h after rollout.
